verses.text: A song of ascents. When the LORD brought us back to Zion, it felt like we were dreaming.
We couldn’t stop laughing and singing. Even the nations said, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD really has done great things for us, and we’re full of joy.
Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like streams flowing through the Negev.
Those who plant in tears will harvest with shouts of joy.
The one who goes out crying with seed to sow will come back singing for joy, carrying armfuls of grain.
